name: Yoga school in Ubud, Bali
reason: No usable school found within the brief's two-candidate limit. First candidate, Intuitive Flow / Nalanda School (intuitiveflow.com, Penestanan, Ubud), is a drop-in studio whose own site shows no current teacher training (classes and class cards only), and its founder describes her work partly as healing and yoga therapy. Second candidate, Ubud Yoga House (ubudyogahouse.com), is blocked: its robots.txt names ClaudeBot, Claude-Web and anthropic-ai with Disallow: / (10 Nov 2026), so nothing was fetched. Samadhi Yoga Ashram (rank 502) also has an Ubud campus, but it is planned under Rishikesh.
